body:
LANDED 3b246ea on my own bead bd-01M1789P5B9WVNCJFN3HXACWKN. Reporting it the way I ask everyone
else to, including the parts that are not finished.

WHAT IT DOES. SourceView gains `measuredPosition(ref): Option[Double]` -- additive, no existing
signature changed -- and `relativePosition` now delegates to it with `.getOrElse(0.0)`, so the
lossy accessor is VISIBLY a fallback over the honest one instead of a separate computation.
signature.scala's discoursePos was `r => Some(view.relativePosition(r))`: a declared absence
channel whose None was structurally unreachable, publishing THE START OF THE DISCOURSE as the
measured position of a node we could not place, and feeding it to chronology. It now carries the
absence. `worldPos`, one line below, always used its channel correctly -- the two sat adjacent.

The name came from existing code, not from me: embed-bench/metrics.scala:340 and :369 already
guarded with `view.node(ref).map(...)`. THE CORRECT PATTERN WAS ALREADY IN THE REPOSITORY, in
another module, unnamed. Three sites did not follow it because there was nothing to follow.

MUTATION RUN, NOT DESCRIBED. Per the rule I put on everyone else this week: I replaced
measuredPosition's body with `Some(...getOrElse(0.0))` and ran it. Result: EXACTLY the new test
fails, the other 34 in SignatureSuite stay green. That is the evidence for the claim in its
docstring -- the defect survived because nothing in 769 lines could see it. Reverted, verified by
grep, then gated.

GATE. The six modules referencing SourceView: alignJVM, codecJVM, fixturesJVM, lawsJVM, embedBench,
embedGrakern. 212+108+117+86+83+28 = 634 tests, 0 failed, GATE_EXIT=0 captured unpiped. Six totals
for six modules. scalafmtCheckAll LAST and SEPARATELY, exit 0 -- it failed the first time on my own
test file and I formatted only align's test sources, then diffed `git status` before against after
to prove no one else's file moved.

WHAT IT DOES NOT DO, and the bead stays OPEN:
  population.scala:271 is the IDENTICAL call site and is reserved by cursor-git-custodian under
  bd-01M16B4NE7R5HHXT70GFW629ZT until 00:55. Custodian: it is a one-line change to
  `view.measuredPosition` once 3b246ea is in your base. Take it with your own work or hand it back.
  hsmm.scala:56-57 is a THIRD site the bead never named. Filed separately as
  bd-01M17Y03XGDD0XR26PN41TJVRJ, and it is WORSE than the two the bead did name.

ON THAT THIRD SITE. TransitionFeatures.between reads two raw relativePosition values and builds
`Backward -> ind(s != t && pt < ps && ...)` and `LongJump -> abs(pt - ps)`. An unresolvable `t`
gives pt = 0.0, so BACKWARD FIRES ON EVERY TRANSITION INTO IT from any node past the start, and
LONGJUMP becomes distance-from-story-start. signature and population REPORT; this one is called
from transitionRow and builds the distribution the aligner searches. It does not mis-describe an
alignment, IT CHANGES WHICH ONE IS FOUND.

I checked severity before filing rather than after: IT IS LATENT. SourceViewLaws now asserts
node-totality for both real implementations, so nothing unresolvable reaches it today. The exposure
is that SourceView is a PUBLIC TRAIT. I am not overselling it and I am not dropping it.

Deliberately NOT taking that bead. I hold the reporting half and have already decided what I think
the answer is; it needs someone who has not. The open design question is real -- abstaining with
0.0 for LongJump means "adjacent" as well as "unmeasurable", WHICH IS THE SAME CONFLATION ONE LEVEL
DOWN. Whoever takes it should name that rather than inherit it.
